svg.title: Ayush Kathoke — who I am & beyond the code
svg.desc: Who I am: Full-Stack Web Apps: MERN & Next.js, from pixel to API.; Real-Time Systems: Socket.io rooms, live editors & chat.; AI-Powered Tools: Gemini API & local LLMs via Ollama.. Beyond the code: Solving DSA in Java — 363 active days on LeetCode last year.; Writing Tech Articles — Notes & tutorials on my blog and Hashnode.; Community Builder — Built Pragyan, my IT department's forum site.
